profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer, Full-Stack Polyglot Architect
profile.summary: I am a software developer with a passion for learning and experience working in fast-paced environments. I enjoy tackling technical challenges and embracing the idioms of whatever language or tool I am using. I strive to share my technical and process knowledge with those around me to improve efficiency, satisfaction, and happiness of my coworkers.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Lead multidisciplinary team to architect, build a Java plugin to connect product backend model data to a new class of customer using MBSE tools. Interfaced with customer, performed project management, task decomposition, and technical mentorship while individually contributing, Contributes to component software integration platform product to integrate custom software and dependencies in CI/CD pipelines, message queues, and APIs running on Kubernetes, Contributed on several successful customer projects using the platform to integrate customer workflows and custom code across multiple technology stacks
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Git · Go (Programming Language) · Elixir · Leading Development Teams · Agile Project Management · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Cyber Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to developing a container registry and build pipeline for government contractors, enabling
faster deployment of functional code, Collaborated on a set of distributed software tools to dynamically generate and allocate VMs, Developed a C++ high-performance video editing and metadata annotation cloud software solution, emphasizing web services and ensuring high availability across multiple teams and developers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created Web Applications using Angular 2/4/5, Python Flask, React, and Node.js
Helped maintain and rewrite a mapping application for first responders and emergency medical personnel using Angular 5, dojo, and Python 
Created iOS applications using the Swift programming language and Xcode
Helped create an application for tracking healthcare facility compliance requirements and scheduling on a team with multiple members
Helped create an application for tracking projects and financials related to projects for an Air Force contractor
Used Docker to run software dependencies in an independent manner
Used AWS services to host and scale web applications
positions.insights: Skills: Web Technologies · Python · Flask · Angular · React.js · Swift (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · hapi.js

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a Python framework with GUI and command line frontend to automate onsite customer
workload, meeting high performance and big data requirements, replacing MATLAB scripts, and enhancing functionality,  Utilized artificial intelligence computing concepts, Trained scientists and analyst on Python usage and software development best practices, including Subversion version
control
positions.insights: Skills: Python · MATLAB · Technical Leadership · Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Rails Apprentice
positions.description:
Implemented a web solution within working Rails e-commerce site to allow users to bargain on order price
Improved, debugged and extended existing code base within all levels of the Rails web stack
Interacted with multiple internal and external web services, such as Amazon Web Services to deliver solutions
Used high level tools to manage networked resources for application infrastructure purposes, such as Heroku
Used testing and red, green refactoring to ensure correct application behavior
Participated within a team using a truly agile, rapid process to develop solutions to specific customer needs Interacted directly with customer via Basecamp and conference calls to discover customer need and to refine design and implementation of solutions
positions.insights: Skills: Web Technologies · Ruby on Rails · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Heroku

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Implemented a Java RESTful Web Service to connect multiple, diverse web services together to deliver full motion video.
Used Qt C++ to modify a Firefox plugin use HTTPS based on stored certificate files.
Interfaced with a Google Earth Firefox plugin via JavaScript using OWF to display geometries based on video metadata.
positions.insights: Skills: REST · Java · Qt · C++ · JavaScript

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Fixed bugs reported, implemented new features, and change requests made by customer using C#, Java, and XSLT focusing on the collection of mission information.
Designed and implemented a website using JSF 2.0 according to formal requirements using reusable software principles throughout for flexibility in the future.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Java · XSLT · JavaServer Faces (JSF)

positions.title: Intern Software Developer
positions.description:
Performed bug fixes to software using Qt C++, and Java. 
Created numerous Python scripts that interacted within a larger system of scripts to automate the processing and organization of video files and their metadata
positions.insights: Skills: Qt · C++ · Java · Python (Programming Language) · Python

positions.title: Computer Programming Assistant Level I
positions.description:
Debugged solutions which were partially to fully implemented but not performing as expected
Delivered explanation of defects within a student's program to better teach them programming concepts
Guided students to alter solutions to fit problem descriptions using Java and C++

volunteerExperiences.description:
Girl Develop It is a nonprofit organization that provides affordable programs for adult women interested in learning web and software development in a judgment-free environment.

● Co-host online and in-person mentoring, training and social events
● Develop content and training guides for members on topics related to software development (Bash, Git, and Github)
● Tools used: Slack, Git, Github, Ruby, Rails, Jekyll, Google Docs
